capabilities.name: agent-mail
capabilities.purpose: Use when coordinating agents with Agent Mail locks, inboxes, threads, and conflict-prevention handoffs.

capabilities.name: agent-native
capabilities.purpose: Make an out-of-session Claude (Managed Agent or Agent SDK loop) AgentOps-native — via skills + the ao CLI + CI, not hooks.

capabilities.name: autodev
capabilities.purpose: Manage the PROGRAM.md/AUTODEV.md contract that drives the loop — the config layer Evolve and Factory read each tick, not a loop itself.

capabilities.name: automation-shape-routing
capabilities.purpose: Front door for agent automation — decide the SHAPE (Workflow vs NTM vs skill), then hand off. Triggers: "build automation", "convert skills to workflows", "which shape".

capabilities.name: bd-first-memory-migration
capabilities.purpose: Consolidate fragmented agent-memory layers into one bd-canonical store, then GC/retire the rest. Triggers: "memory migration", "consolidate agent memory", "beads-first memory".

capabilities.name: beads
capabilities.purpose: Track issues with bd/br, triage with bv, and convert plans to beads.

capabilities.name: beads-workflow
capabilities.purpose: Use when converting markdown plans into br beads with dependencies for implementation or swarm execution.

capabilities.name: burndown
capabilities.purpose: Drive a finite epic set to all-merged, then stop.

capabilities.name: caam
capabilities.purpose: Use when switching AI coding CLI accounts quickly to recover from subscription rate limits or OAuth friction.

capabilities.name: cass
capabilities.purpose: Mine past agent sessions for working prompts, decisions, and patterns. Use when "what did I ask?", "find that prompt", session archaeology, or agent history.

capabilities.name: cass-memory
capabilities.purpose: Use when starting non-trivial work, mining lessons, or preventing repeated mistakes with cm procedural memory.

capabilities.name: council
capabilities.purpose: Run multi-judge consensus. Use when: an irreversible or high-stakes decision needs independent judges before committing — architecture forks, one-way doors, scoring options.

capabilities.name: curate
capabilities.purpose: Mine transcripts, .agents, bd, and git for skill diffs, bd updates, or

capabilities.name: design
capabilities.purpose: Validate product fit before discovery. Use when: framing a problem, checking product/market fit, or pressure-testing user value before writing a discovery packet or any code.

capabilities.name: doc
capabilities.purpose: Generate and validate repo docs (default), READMEs (--mode=readme), and OSS doc packs (--mode=oss).

capabilities.name: domain
capabilities.purpose: Canonical vocabulary for human-AI software work.

capabilities.name: eval-outcomes
capabilities.purpose: Grade against Outcomes as a holdout-safe projection of the locked eval substrate — one bar, many runtimes.

capabilities.name: gh-actions
capabilities.purpose: Use when creating GitHub Actions workflows, release automation, checksums, signing, or CI/CD.

capabilities.name: operating-loop-workflow
capabilities.purpose: Install and run the operating-loop multi-agent Workflow (the seven-move loop) for AgentOps plugin users.

capabilities.name: post-mortem
capabilities.purpose: Review completed work and learn. Use when: a task, PR arc, or session is finished and you want to extract learnings, or after ≥5 PRs (the scope checkpoint).

capabilities.name: pre-mortem
capabilities.purpose: Stress-test plans before work. Use when: a plan is drafted but not yet executed and you want to surface failure modes, risks, and what would prove it wrong before committing.

capabilities.name: process-triage
capabilities.purpose: Use when diagnosing runaway processes with the pt wrapper and choosing safe remediation.

capabilities.name: rch
capabilities.purpose: Use when offloading slow builds to remote workers or recovering RCH worker, hook, SSH, sync, or disk issues.

capabilities.name: red-team
capabilities.purpose: Probe docs and skills. Use when: adversarially probing a doc, skill, plan, or claim for weaknesses, gaps, or unstated assumptions before it ships.

capabilities.name: repeatedly-apply-skill
capabilities.purpose: Use when applying a skill repeatedly with progressive deepening for iterative improvement.

capabilities.name: review
capabilities.purpose: Review diffs for risk, find mocks, scan for bugs, audit codebases. Use when: reviewing a diff/PR for bugs and risk, hunting mocks/stubs/placeholders, or auditing for quality.

capabilities.name: ru-multi-repo-workflow
capabilities.purpose: Use when using ru for multi-repo commits, sync, GitHub review, or maintenance automation.

capabilities.name: scaffold
capabilities.purpose: Create project, component, or boilerplate scaffolds.

capabilities.name: scope
capabilities.purpose: Hard-block edits outside declared frozen directories via PreToolUse hook.

capabilities.name: session-bootstrap
capabilities.purpose: Universal init prompt — every agent spawned into an AgentOps repo runs `ao session bootstrap` first.

capabilities.name: ship-loop
capabilities.purpose: Bot-paired fast-lane cycle for coherent-arc internal PRs (one closable bead or small-epic slice): claim → test → impl → pre-push → push → squash auto-merge → close.

capabilities.name: skill-auditor
capabilities.purpose: Audit an existing SKILL.md against the unified AgentOps template (15

capabilities.name: skill-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold or absorb new SKILL.md files against the unified AgentOps template. Triggers: "create a skill", "scaffold skill", "absorb external skill", "new skill".

capabilities.name: ssh
capabilities.purpose: Use when configuring SSH access, keys, tunnels, host diagnostics, or safe remote command workflows.

capabilities.name: system-performance-remediation
capabilities.purpose: Use when restoring machine responsiveness from high CPU, memory, IO, cache, or runaway process pressure.

capabilities.name: system-tuning
capabilities.purpose: Restore system responsiveness via safe, ordered process cleanup and agent-swarm

capabilities.name: ubs
capabilities.purpose: Use when reviewing code with UBS for bugs, security issues, AI-generated quality, or pre-commit checks.

capabilities.name: using-ntm
capabilities.purpose: Use NTM as the out-of-session substrate: spawn Claude/Codex panes running /rpi and /evolve over a bead queue, then tend the swarm to convergence.

capabilities.name: validate
capabilities.purpose: Produce PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts for artifacts, plans, code, PRs, or gates. Use when: you need a structured verdict on an artifact, plan, code, PR, or CI gate before proceeding.

capabilities.name: vibe
capabilities.purpose: Validate code readiness. Use when: doing a quick readiness or sanity check that code is ready to commit or ship, short of a full review.

capabilities.name: vibing-with-ntm
capabilities.purpose: Use when tending NTM agent swarms, unsticking panes, handling rate limits, or coordinating convergence.

capabilities.name: workflow-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold a new Claude Workflow script — deterministic multi-agent orchestration. Triggers: "build a workflow", "create a workflow", "scaffold workflow", "author a workflow".
